snippet.title: JUBAKU | Official Main Trailer | Steam Next Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Something is terribly wrong inside the Tanaka Residence.

Set in Japan in 1991, JUBAKU is a psychological horror game where you play as an American journalist investigating reports of missing visitors and unexplained incidents inside a seemingly ordinary home.

Armed with a camera, you'll uncover hidden evidence, explore the house's disturbing past, and discover things that were never meant to be seen.

But the longer you stay, the more you begin to question what is real.

🩸 JUBAKU is part of Steam Next Fest!

🏚️ Play the FREE demo on Steam and experience the Tanaka Residence for yourself.

⭐ Wishlist JUBAKU on Steam to support our small indie team and stay updated on development.

🎮 Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4911730/Jubaku/
